blogs.title: From 4K to 2 Million: Why Context Length Matters and How We Got Stuck
blogs.description: An accessible primer on why LLM context windows matter for in‑context learning, long documents, and agents. Explains the common RoPE-based approaches (PI, NTK, YaRN), why they plateau around ~128k tokens, and how crowding and out-of-distribution positions derail performance.

blogs.title: Meet LongRoPE: The Idea That Stretched LLM Memory to 2M Tokens
blogs.description: A high-level tour of LongRoPE’s core insight: positional information in RoPE isn’t uniform. Breaks down the two key non-uniformities—across RoPE dimensions and across token positions—and how respecting them preserves information, enabling dramatic length extensions with minimal tuning.

blogs.title: Evolution at Work: How LongRoPE Searches Better Positions Instead of Guessing
blogs.description: Demystifies the evolutionary search behind LongRoPE. Covers the search space, smart initialization using PI/NTK/YaRN, the monotonicity constraint that slashes compute, and why this automated approach beats hand-designed rules for finding per-dimension rescale factors.

blogs.title: The 3-Step Path to 2M Tokens: Progressive Extension Without Breaking the Bank
blogs.description: Explains LongRoPE’s practical recipe to reach 2048k: 8× extension without fine-tuning, short fine-tuning within 256k (about 1k steps), then a second search to jump to 2M tokens. Also details the ‘short-context recovery’ trick to keep 4k–8k performance intact.

blogs.title: Does It Actually Work? Perplexity, Passkeys, and Benchmarks You Care About
blogs.description: Summarizes results across LLaMA2 and Mistral: stable perplexity up to 2M tokens, >90% passkey retrieval across lengths, and competitive scores on standard short-context benchmarks. Interprets what these numbers mean for real-world reliability and trade-offs.

blogs.title: Plugging In LongRoPE: A Practitioner’s Guide to Extending Your LLM
blogs.description: A practical walkthrough for engineers: when to use search vs. fine-tuning, dataset needs, compute tips, dynamic switching for short sequences (e.g., <8k), and how LongRoPE leaves model architecture intact so you can reuse existing optimizations.

blogs.title: What 2M Tokens Unlock: New Products, Research Directions, and Caveats
blogs.description: Explores applications enabled by million-token contexts—long-document QA and synthesis, multi-session agents, codebases and EHRs, and legal discovery—plus caveats like attention dilution, data scarcity for ultra-long texts, and how to choose your fine-tune length.
